problem.title: Minimum Limit of Balls in a Bag
problem.problemStatement: You are given bags containing balls. In one operation, you may split a bag into two non-empty bags. Return the minimum possible maximum number of balls in any bag after performing at most maxOperations operations.
problem.input: Integer n Array nums Integer maxOperations
